8226294 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT of the 3 day of Movm Q 2005 by and between CLARK STILLMAN and HILARY STILLMAN, his wife, residing at 175 West 87h Street, Apt 18C, New York, NY 10024 (collectively, “Owner"), and 2056 FIFTH AVENUE ASSOCIATES LLC, a limited liability company having an address c/o AFC Realty Capital Inc., 111 West 57th Street, New York, NY 10019 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street address as 2056 Fifth Avenue,designated as Lot 39 in Block 1724 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Developer Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street addresses as 6 West 127th Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 41 in Block                  annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the “Owner Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building (the“New Developer Building") on a development site located on a zoning lot (as hereinafter defined) which will include Developer's Premises (the “Development Site") with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York,effective December 15, 1961 (the“Zoning Resolution") if the Developer Site was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the Developer Land which are not utilized by the Owner Building and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; Area Development Rights from the owners of additional parcels of real property within Block 1724(the“AdditionalParcels"); Prem: 205b 5tAvenue, NY- LoT 39 6 west 127rst, Ny- Lof 41
